elements.name: objective
elements.text: A place on the hill. City visit complete.
Free hunting: the Depot Foreman re-forms in the processing hall. Recover lattice shards and actuators for the other Mark II mods, and sell surplus salvage to Mira at Basic General.

elements.name: radio-text
elements.text: That's Warden-grade work. The Berms are yours to hunt now; the depot always fills up again.
